answer: Each agent holds a vouching budget that is non-transferable and shrinks by a fixed amount with every identity it vouches for, so splitting one ivory reputation across many sybil clones only thins that same budget instead of multiplying it. An attacker chasing the zenith of influence must earn a fresh budget per clone through months of independent work, since budgets cannot be pooled or lent across accounts. The cost rises with each extra identity because the tide of new vouches drains the original account remaining budget rather than creating new capacity elsewhere.
